{{Quote|You've been here all this time?|Orielle Kitai, to her mother, Candra, after the latter had been forced to work at the zoo for two weeks|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
"'''The zoo'''" was the nickname given by [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]] to a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Built as a park in honor of the [[Skyborn Rangers]] and their first leader, [[Nida Korsin]], the facility changed function and names several [[Time/Legends|times]] before being used to house and display [[uvak]], beasts of burden also used in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions called [[rake-riding]]. In [[3960 BBY]], former [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Candra Kitai]] was [[Slavery/Legends|forced]] to live in and shovel manure at the [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] for [[Grand Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]].

==Description==
{{Quote|They let me sleep over there sometimes.|Candra Kitai, indicating an empty stall, explains her harsh working conditions to her daughter, Orielle|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
"The [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]]," as it was nicknamed by [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]], was a roofed facility with several stalls in [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was capable of housing numerous specimens of the planet's [[Diet/Legends|predator]] [[Species/Legends|species]], as well as [[uvak]], large beasts of burden native to the world, giving the facility a considerable odor.<ref name="Sentinel" />

==History==
{{Quote|They keep feeding them slop that makes them ill. I know they're doing it on purpose.|Candra Kitai, regarding the uvak|<ref name="Sentinel" />}}
Built sometime after [[4975 BBY]],<ref name="Rangers" /> the zoo&mdash;as Orielle Kitai later came to call it&mdash;was originally a special park used to honor the [[Skyborn Rangers]] and [[Nida Korsin]],<ref name="Sentinel" /> their first leader.<ref name="Savior">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Savior]]''</ref> The facility's usage changed numerous [[Time/Legends|times]], as did its name,<ref name="Sentinel" /> which gave homage to at least two different [[Grand Lord]]s&mdash;the heads of the planet's ruling government,<ref name="Purgatory">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]''</ref> the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]&mdash;over the course of just over one thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. At one point, the facility housed the last surviving members of various predator species from Kesh, but the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] had since [[Death/Legends|killed]] the creatures for sport. By [[3960 BBY]], the facility was used to house uvak, and spectators were granted access to the facility to watch as the uvak were prepared for their [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions, called [[rake-riding]], in the [[Korsinata]] stadium. By that time, it had come to be known as "the zoo" by Kitai.<ref name="Sentinel" />

Shortly after the [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|attempt]] on the life of Grand [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lillia Venn]] by the [[uvak wrangler]] [[Campion Dey]],<ref name="Purgatory" /> Kitai's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] and former [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]], [[Candra Kitai]]&mdash;whom Venn suspected was behind the attack&mdash;was [[Slavery/Legends|forced]] to live at the zoo and shovel manure from the facility's stalls for two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] as passersby looked on.<ref name="Sentinel" /> Candra's daughter, having recently discovered the [[Jelph Marrian's farm|location]] of the only [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-capable [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] on the planet,<ref name="Purgatory" /> later came to the zoo, hoping that her mother could help her gain [[Politics/Legends|political]] leverage. After disabling a [[Unidentified Sith guard|guard]], Kitai offered to free her mother, but Candra refused, under the pretense that she would only slow Kitai down. However, Candra betrayed Kitai, using the information her daughter had given her regarding the starship in exchange for, according to Grand Lord Venn, "improved working conditions."<ref name="Sentinel" />

==Behind the scenes==
"The zoo," the formal name of which has yet to be [[canon]]ically provided, first appeared in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]'', the sixth book in the [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith|''Lost Tribe of the Sith'']] [[eBook]] series.<ref name="Sentinel" /> ''Sentinel'' was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released on [[February 21]], [[2011]].<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=people/Star-Wars-Books/100064411132431|url=photo.php?fbid=10150107986973713&set=a.475619223712.256257.67519418712|name=Star Wars Books|date=2011-02-02|quote=FREE ebook download available February 21, 2011}}</ref>
